senses.gloss:
धूलि, इस्, m. f. or धूली, f. (perhaps connected
with rt. ध्वस् or ध्वंस्, cf. धूसर), dust; powder;
[cf. गन्ध-ध्˚, गो-ध्˚]; a particular number.
—धूलि-कुट्टिम, अम्, n. or धूलि-केदार, अस्,
m. a mound, rampart of earth.
—धूलि-गुच्छक,
अस्, m. the red fragrant vegetable powder thrown
about at the spring festival called the Holi.
—धूलि-
धूम्र, अस्, आ, अम्, dark-red or dark with dust.
—धूलि-ध्वज, अस्, m. ‘dust-marked,’ ‘whose
sign is dust,’ air or wind.
—धूलि-पुष्पिका, f. the
plant Pandanus Odoratissimus; [cf. केतकी.]
—धूलि-
मय, अस्, ई, अम्, covered with dust.
—धूलि-मुष्टि,
इस्, m. f. a handful of dust.
—धूलिमुष्टि-प्र-
क्षेप, अस्, m. the throwing of handfuls of dust.
—धूली-कदम्ब or धूली-कदम्बक or धूलि-
कदम्ब or धूलि-कदम्बक, अस्, m. the plant
Dalbergia Ougeinensis (= तिनिश); a species of the
Kadamba tree, Nauclea Cordifolia (= नीप); Cap-
paris Trifoliata (= वरुण).
—धूली-पटल, अस्, m.
a cloud of dust.
धूलिका, f. fog, mist, (from its dust-like appearance.)
